notes.title: 🎉 The Demo is Live! 🎉
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to announce that the Few Shall Return Demo is now available to play on Steam! 🚀[/p][p]This demo gives you a first taste of what we’ve been building, and we can’t wait to hear what you think. Here’s what you can expect in this version:[/p][p][/p][h3]✨ Key Features in the Demo[/h3][list][*][p]Explore the dungeon and try the combat system[/p][/*][*][p]Meet some of the early characters[/p][/*][*][p]Experience the first puzzle to unlock the inner dungeon[/p][/*][*][p]Not everyone leaves: fight for a chance to escape[/p][/*][/list][p]Your feedback during this stage means the world to us—it will help us polish the game and shape what comes next. Please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the on our Discord.[/p][p][/p][h3]🔓 How is the demo different than the full game?[/h3][list][*][p]There's only one map in the demo. The full game has an infinite number of maps because they are procedurally generated.[/p][/*][*][p]You can only play with others through invite codes in the demo. In the full game, you can also join random matches through matchmaking.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]⚡ What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’ll continue updating the demo and adding content as we work toward the full release. The next Demo update is planned for Sept 26.[/p][p]Thank you for checking out the demo and supporting our journey. We hope you enjoy your first adventure in Few Shall Return! 💙[/p][p][/p][p]-- The Ballard Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Extending the playtest!
notes.content: [p]We were planning on keeping the playtest open only during the weekend but we got so much positive feedback that we've decided to extend it and let you folks play more.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtest will now run through Sunday the 27th of July.[/p][p][/p][p]If you're encountering issues during the playtest or you want to chat with us, [url="https://discord.gg/5f47qudGh8"]join us in Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]- The Ballard Games team[/p]

notes.title: Open Playtest Jul 18-20
notes.content: [p]Join us to play Few Shall Return! From July 18 through July 20, we're running an open playtest on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]Help us test the new matchmaking feature, new maps/rooms, and a new category of equipment![/p][p][/p][p]If you're encountering issues during the playtest or you want to chat with us, [url="https://discord.gg/5f47qudGh8"]join us in Discord[/url].[/p]

notes.title: Playtest!
notes.content:
🎉 We're hosting our first public playtest! During the event time, you'll be able to play the game and/or watch the developers do it.

[b]To join the playtest[/b]: go to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3377400/Few_Shall_Return/]Few Shall Return Stream Page[/url] and click "Request Access".

If you're encountering issues during the playtest or you want to chat with us, [url=https://discord.gg/5f47qudGh8]join us in Discord[/url].

[b]NOTE[/b]: The game will be playable on May 10 from 8AM to 8PM Pacific time. Once the playtest is over, the game will not be playable anymore until the next playtest session.
